Activity Monitor 1.10.1 refines the macOS title bar controls.

- Centered the metric tabs, app mark, and right-side actions in matching toolbar slots. The tab surface now matches the right-side panel height, with more even vertical spacing in both labeled and compact icon layouts.
- Removed the pale native toolbar capsule that appeared behind the app mark on macOS 26.

### Install

Use **Check for Updates…** in Activity Monitor 1.10.0, or download the universal DMG or ZIP for Apple silicon and Intel on macOS 14 or later. `SHA256SUMS` verifies the downloads; the update feed and archive are signed with Ed25519.

[Changes since 1.10.0](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ActivityMonitor/compare/v1.10.0...v1.10.1)
